limits: Wheel and rivet POSITION values are measured candidates. All normals/UVs/indices are explicitly retained either in wheel payload or full fallback.

All other source fields remain exact, including node103. Rivet residual.bin explicitly retains 58 unlearned components, including whole node57. Any reader rod conversion is separate explicit postprocessing.
Whole-field hash deduplication is storage reuse, not generated shape coverage.
Generated-field SHA is a strict cross-engine gate. Node validation does not certify Chrome/Safari/iOS Math.sin/cos equivalence. No relaxed hash fallback.
Definitions, animations, materials and licensed textures remain source-derived. No engineering dimensions or full source-independent reconstruction claimed.
